reviews_list.review_title: Review of Aditya College of Engineering.

review_content.Placements: Many students in my college have joined the CSE course only. In M.Tech, many preferred the CSE course. My batch has a lot of students in CSE. The highest package in my college is 20 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA per annum. Many top companies in India have offered jobs in my academic year. Very few students go for internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good. The infrastructure is very good. There are canteens, labs that are well-equipped, and nice classrooms with CC cameras. There is one small library, and students can go to the library at any time. There is a small medical clinic for hostelers only. There is free time for students, so we can play during that time.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Best and good placements.

review_content.Placements: Around 85% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 10 LPA and the lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Accenture, Google, and Microsoft. The top roles were Project Manager and Software Developer. Around 60% of students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities were good, with separate hostels for boys and girls. The mess was good. Water purifiers and washing machines were available. The infrastructure was good. The classrooms were neat, and labs were well-equipped. The library was good. Wi-Fi was not available. The medical facilities were good.

reviews_list.review_title: A challenging and good college.

review_content.Placements: 70 to 75% percent of students got placed. The highest salary package is 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Google and Microsoft. Around 65% percent of students got an internship. The top roles are project manager and software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides good infrastructure. The college building is good. The classrooms are big with comfortable benches. The computer labs are good with internet connection. There are many books in the library. The hostel facilities are good. The canteen is also available. The sports facilities are good.

review_content.Placements: In this college, there are many facilities available, and there is the best package provided by the companies. This company is providing a 3 LPA to 7 LPA package. There are companies providing placements based on the knowledge and grade obtained by passing the exam.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is a nice college.

review_content.Placements: The top recruiting companies for our course are Baja Electronics, Tata Steel, and Larsen and Toubro. Nearly 80% of students got internships in top companies. 90% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. It provides major roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my course is below average. It has just a simple infrastructure, not so attractive and even not good. Labs are really so bad. Classrooms of my course are like school. The library is not available for anyone and they just say that the library is open 24x7 but it is not real at all. The hostel infrastructure is below average, and no one likes it. The food in the hostel mess is very bad. Food is like animals' food, and they think we are animals. There is no medical facility. Games are good here.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the way of teaching faculty members, good placements, and well maintained.

review_content.Placements: Almost 73.5% of students were placed in my course. There are many top recruiting companies that offer the highest salary packages. Some of them are Cargill, Excelr, Palle Technologies, SMS Infrastructure, Schneider Electric, Polycab India, etc. The highest salary package offered is 5.66 LPA by Cargill. The lowest salary package offered is 1.98 LPA by Hyoseong Electric. The average salary package offered ranges from 3 LPA to 5 LPA by Excelr (Based on the interview performance).
review_content.Infrastructure: When coming to the facilities and infrastructure, there are specialized labs for EEE courses, such as electrical machines lab, power electronics lab, control systems lab, electronics lab, etc. We have modern classrooms with teaching aids like projectors, whiteboards, etc. A well-stocked library with books, journals, and online databases relevant to EEE are also available. Mess facilities typically provide both vegetarian and non-vegetarian. Basic medical facilities and tie-ups with nearby hospitals for emergencies. Facilities for indoor and outdoor sports like cricket, volleyball, badminton, etc., are available.

placements.overview:

During Darshan University placements 2025 the B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering also reports a 100% placement rate, supported by 26 companies . The B.Com . program maintains a 100% placement rate with offers from 10 companies . The BBA program mirrors this success with a 100% placement rate and participation from 20 companies. In contrast, the MBA program has an 81% placement rate, with offers from 20 companies . Lastly, the MCA program also records an 81% placement rate, with the highest package recorded during Darshan University placements was INR 5.00 LPA and an average package of INR 2 37 LPA, from 22 companies.

reviews.review_heading: University offers good infrastructure and supportive faculty with comfortable campus.
reviews.review_text: Darshan campus has good infrastructure, with a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Classrooms and labs are clean and provide projector teaching. There are different labs for all the different technologies and operating systems. On campus, there are many canteens that offer all kinds of food items. Hostel rooms are clean and safe, and the hostel mess provides delicious food. For all sports activities, both indoor and outdoor, there is a separate space available.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and campus and good curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Every class has average computers but most classes and labs have air conditioning. Hostel is great with AC and 24-hour Wi-Fi facilities. While the library has great books and mostly good environment. Wi-Fi is also available in the canteen and library. Hostel have facilities like AC, Wi-Fi, gym, playgrounds, etc. Mess and canteen are also good but not best medical facilities are available here for students and teachers.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good and best.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is only in the reading room, not in the campus or classrooms. Classrooms have AC. The hostel is to much good quality but expensive. Some students live there as they come from very far, and they enjoyed much in the college. The food at the hostel is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the university is good for education but it does not orgnaises events like other colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The campus is very clean and day by day it is cleaned by workers. The hostel is very good. It provides separate hostels for both girls and boys with good food.

reviews.review_heading: Best ever placements last year (2023), really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Very good speed Wi-Fi available, so many computer labs with the latest brand-new computers, nice classrooms with such a good environment, best library I ever saw in my study journey. Very nice and varietal food available and nice medical facilities, very good sports club.

reviews.review_heading: Really excellent college for me.
reviews.review_text: Darshan University provides full facilities to students, like a library, reading room, and gym facilities for hostel students. In the Darshan University hostel, we provide students with a daily new menu. Medical facilities also available. For sports, there is a big cricket ground, and indoor games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent teaching, good infrastructure, good rules and average placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good, the class room,labs, auditoriums they are very clean. But, in some labs computers are very slow, someone ruined monitor with ink, keyboard is not good, sometime mouse is not working. And Wifi is ok like it works good normally but when giving mid-exams in computer it lags.

reviews.review_heading: Gurukul of modern world .
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is equipped with modern technology. If I talk about the hostel, it is worth it; it is equipped with a gym, Wi-Fi, and has 3 students in a room, along with many other facilities. The meal provided is of good quality. A good meal is offered. The college has a vast collection of books, journals, CDs, DVDs, and e-books, and also has a membership with other libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Darshan University .
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus for the students. Labs are fully equipped with new computers and great seating facilities. Classrooms are also equipped with A/C and there is a projector in every classroom. The library is also well-equipped with many books, and there is a reading room as well.

reviews.review_heading: A brief introduction to Darshan University.
reviews.review_text: There are so many facilities available in our college, such as a computer lab, measurements labs, workshop, testing lab, library, and Wi-Fi on full campus. All sports equipment are also available, such as football, basketball, cricket, kabaddi, chess, carrom, table tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is really good for studying, not for other activities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Darshan University is very good, so students can study very smoothly and very carefully. It's hostel facility is very good, and the WiFi is also good. Classroom facilities are also good, as is the library, so students can study carefully and easily.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Darshan University.
reviews.review_text: Campus has a bad Wi-Fi connection, but the new lab has much better Wi-Fi. The labs have really good computers with 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD, and i5 12th gen processors. There is a huge library in the college, and many canteens are available for food. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Darshan University.
reviews.review_text: In our college, computer and other labs are too good with all facilities like Wi-Fi, projectors, and many more things. I am not part of the college hostel, so I do not have much knowledge about it. But according to my knowledge, its food quality is better than private hostels, but fees are very expensive for the middle class.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories are good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled but does not work properly. Triple occupancy hostel rooms are available. Both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms are available. There is a well-stocked library in this college. Mess is excellent. Sports are average in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Darshan University is very good.
reviews.review_text: The university has laboratories, Wi-Fi, computer, classrooms, projectors, and a common library for all departments. There is a decent library in this college. There are around 35 computers in our college. Hostel is very good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Playground is available. Bus facility is also available in this college.

overview_faqs.question: Why choose Singhania University?
overview_faqs.answer: Singhania University is a private university established in 2007. The university is recognised by UGC and AICTE. It has been approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI) for its Law programmes. Additionally, the university's architecture programmes are accredited by the Council of Architecture (COA).Singhania University courses are available at undergraduate, postgraduate, postgraduate diploma, doctoral, and online levels. In addition to this, Singhania University Distance Education offers in Teaching, Management, Science, IT, and Traditional courses, among others. Singhania University admission is both entrance and merit-based. According to the Singhania University placements, the the highest package and average package stood at INR 11 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively.

individual_reviews.course: UG Diploma in Fashion Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, decent campus life, and helpful teachers.

content.Placements: Around 60% of students got placed from my course. The highest package is around 7 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro recruited from our batch. Many students also got internships in startups and design firms, mostly in roles like designer, analyst, or marketing intern, which are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure for academics with Wi-Fi, clean classrooms, and well-equipped labs. The library is decent and has most of the required books. Although the college doesn't have a hostel, there are many PGs nearby with average facilities. The campus has a canteen, basic medical facilities, and some sports options.

individual_reviews.course: Professional Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Science - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: College has good placements and is enjoyable.

content.Placements: About 90% of students are placed in our course. All placements are the same with no differences. Companies like Taj, ITC, Hyatt, Oberoi, and Avasa are involved. Students who have more than 85% attendance get the opportunity to work in five-star hotels. As of now, they are only trainees but have gained good experience in college.

Labs are well-equipped, classrooms are excellent, and quality of facilities for sports and games is really good. Medical facilities are also provided, and food facilities are good as well.

individual_reviews.course: Executive Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Science - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely worth joining.

content.Placements: All 100% of students were provided with national and international internship and placement offers with great packages. All students can get dream jobs and guaranteed placement offers in the dream hotels, cruises, and airlines. Also, they have the chance to start their own businesses and have a great future. Scholarships are also available.
content.Infrastructure: We have a kitchen practice lab, baking and confectionery lab, restaurant, library with lots of books, and computers with internet connection/Wi-Fi for students. We have a computer lab, communication club for enjoyment, lavish classrooms with AC and projectors, canteen, etc. Very clean and tidy campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Fashion and Apparel Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: One of best private college for fashion design in Bangalore.

content.Placements: The college does provide placement opportunities, and last year's students were placed with different brands. However, the starting salary is usually low, which is typical for freshers in the fashion design field.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure and facilities. It has well-maintained classrooms with AC, a library, a sewing lab, medical facilities, and restrooms. The college does not provide hostel facilities, so students must find their own accommodations nearby.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Hotel Management - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied only with placements and faculties.

content.Placements: I feel really proud to say that our college provides 100% placement during (part time and odc) and after the course. Also, most of my batchmates have gotten internship in well-reputed 5-star hotels like Shangri-La, Hyatt, etc. My seniors got placed abroad, like in the USA and Poland, with an average salary of 2 lacs, approx.
content.Infrastructure: Campus is a bit small but doesn't have a playground or hostel. All classrooms are air conditioned. All labs are too good and well maintained. The library has a good collection of books. The college is built roadside and getting a place for parking is a big task.

faqs.question: Can I get a fee refund if I choose to withdraw my admission from Singhania University BA course?
faqs.answer: Yes, Singhania University refunds the fees if a student withdraws/cancels their admission within the stipulated time. The university follows the fee refund policy prescribed by UGC. The fees will be refunded based on the following UGC guidelines: In case of cancellations of admissions/migrations of students up to September 30 of admission year, the university shall make full refund of fees with a deduction of not more than INR 1,000 as a processing fee, up to deadline. For any admission schedule extending/commencing beyond October 31 of admission year, the refund of fees shall be made on following basis: Category Refund Percentage Admission withdrawal notified at least 15 days before the official last date of admission 100% Admission withdrawal notified less than 15 days before the official last date of admission 90% Admission withdrawal notified within 15 days after the official last date of admission 80% Admission withdrawal notified after 15 days but within 30 days after the official last date of admission 50% Admission withdrawal notified over 30 days after the official last date of admission 0%

faqs.question: What is the admission process at Xavier University Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: The admission to BM, BCom and BSc are based on the merit. For BSc, candidates need to submit a Statement of Purpose and appear for Personal Interview. For BTech admission, students are required to appear for a written test. The final selection will be based on the Test Score - Personal Interview and academic performance in class 10 and 12 examinations.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to XIM University Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Yes, aspiring students can get direct admission. Xavier University admission for undergraduate and postgraduate courses can be applied directly without an entrance exam. Applicants, for courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, LLB and BM can apply directly or attend personal interview. The selection process determines the applicants and their potential merit. Candidates are evaluated based on academic performance, active engagement and personal impacts in terms of challenges they might have faced and overcome.

faqs.question: How can students get admission to XIMB Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: XIMB Bhubaneswar admission is based in merit and entrance exams. The institute accepts national entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, GMAT, X-GMT, and others. Xavier Institute of Management Bhubaneswar accepts Group Discussions and Personal Interviews for admission. Candidates have to fill out the XIMB application form online through the official website.

faqs.question: Which exams are accepted by the XIM University?
faqs.answer: XIM University Bhubaneswar admissionto various courses is both merit-based and entrance-based. Admission to BTech, BSc, BCom, and BM is offered on the basis of a written test or interview conducted by the university. A candidate's past academic record is also considered at the time of final admission. The candidates have to qualify inCAT/XAT/NMATorX-GMTto secure admission to MBA and Executive MBA programs. Final admission is subject to WAT and GD/ PI conducted by XUB Bhubaneswar. MTech admission is offered completely on the basis of a valid score inOJEE. For a PhD, candidates need to takeUGC NET, followed by an interview. Any other equivalent national or state level examination qualified candidates are also eligible to apply.

review_summary.college_name: CT Group of Institutions (South Campus) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A short review of a very good college and precious college.

content.Placements: This college placement is good nowadays. Around 80% of students get placed here. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Overall, placements are good. Here, top companies like Amazon, Hero, Wipro, Infosys, and Microsoft are top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of college is good but not as good as we compare to other colleges. Even though classes are good but not air-conditioned this is the one fault. Boards are also not as digital as others compared to other colleges. Overall, the infrastructure is good this can be adjusted because fee is also low compared to other colleges.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with staff, good placements in the past few years also, and really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Here also, placements are made based on CGPA. If you have technical skills plus soft skills also, you can easily be placed. It takes a lot of hard work to get placed. You will have to do it on your own, but the staff here is much supportive. They will support you in every case they can. Many top companies came here for internships and placements like Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Coca-Cola, Tech Mahindra, IBM, RBS, Dell, etc. The highest package here for B.Tech is 31 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Open Wi-Fi is available in all departments of college. There are a number of labs here. Classrooms are also quite good. All the departments have their own libraries. Although the campus is quite big. There are number of gardens and ground to hill and relax. Dispensary is also available here. There are several canteens here, or we can say that every department has a canteen. There are much opportunities for sports and cultural activities. Hostel mess food is so good compared to other college hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It provides better placement probability.

content.Placements: Approximately 20% of students have been placed till now. The lowest package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 20 LPA. The college offers placements in companies like Orbit Biotechnology, Verka Milk Plant, and Path Labs. Approximately 60% of students got internships in food industries and labs especially. Roles like food inspector, lab technician, etc., are offered to students.
content.Infrastructure: The college has internet facilities but it is offered only in computer labs on their systems only. CT has its own library which has all books required, and classrooms are very echoey. Hostels are above average with average mess and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Well, it's really good, and placements are also very good compared to other colleges.

content.Placements: Well, placement here is good compared to any private engineering college. Almost 70% of students are placed with a good salary package. The highest salary package offered is 30 LPA and the average salary package offered is 5 LPA - 6 LPA. Almost all big companies come to provide good job opportunities here.
content.Infrastructure: Well, in my course, all facilities were provided, like a supercomputer if we needed it. In my hostel, all facilities were provided, such as a playing ground, common room for meetings, garden, cleaning facilities, pure drinking water, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college is wonderful.

content.Placements: 90% of the students were placed in this course. The highest package was around 9 LPA, and the lowest one was about 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Tommy, Reliance, and Coca-Cola. About 95% of students get internships. The roles differ; some students were posted in administrative positions, while others were selected for management teams.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty cool and fine. Every campus has the facilities of Wi-Fi, and the speed of Wi-Fi is so fast and furious. To get the password of Wi-Fi, one has to register yourself with the department. Hostel facilities are fine, and all games are there.

review_summary.college_name: Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for affordable courses offered by them and scholarship is also offered.

content.Placements: Almost 85% of the students at the college got placement after completing the course. The minimum package for the student is 6-7 lacs per annum. The top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Wipro, Google, and many more. 95% of the students got internships from my college, and it's really good to say that.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good; it includes a library canteen and labs. There is a separate ground to play football and cricket, which is really nice. I was not a hosteler, but my friends say that the food of the mess is really nice, and every Sunday special dishes are offered to the students. College has full coverage of Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: ‘Discipline’ is one word I can use to describe the College.

content.Placements: Companies like Paytm, Zero, ICICI bank, and AU small finance bank visit the campus for placements. CRT classes are arranged to prepare the students for placements and for their personality development. Me and my friend got placed in AU small finance bank. Packages depend on the company and our interview performance. We can expect 4 lacs as an average package. Zero percent students got internships as it is not provided by the college. One students got a TATA internship for multiple works without any stipend.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides Wi-Fi in the campus itself, but the browsing speed is less. Wi-Fi is available in the campus but is mostly dominated by the engineering students. Library is common for us and engineering branches having less space due to which it is always crowded. I did not live in the hostel, I lived with my family in the same city. The average rent is 60,000 per year and both normal and suite rooms are available for the students. Proper hygienic food is prepared in the mess.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A college needs good management.

content.Placements: The placement in college is average. The companies called by the college offer packages of 4-3 LPA. The companies offer roles mostly in the IT sector. In the course, all students got internships based on their own skills. Mostly, placements are off-campus, qualified by the students.
content.Infrastructure: The whole infrastructure of the college is good. But the condition of the labs is so bad that no practicals can be done on the system. The quality of food provided is average. Wi-Fi facility is provided to the students for study. The environment of the classroom is good in the college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: College campus is very good.

content.Placements: Companies like Paytm, arxtramarks, icici bank, bank etc. Visit the campus for placements. CRT classes are arranged to prepare the students for placement and their personality development. After B.Com I had two options for p. g. and from them I chose MBA. I was looking for an college with best faculty members and also in budget. I got to know about this college from a friend.
content.Infrastructure: Girls and boys are in equal no. Every Week seminars are held. Seminars on most trending topics are held time to time. College do no support any kind of race religion based group. They tend to provide general awareness about recent economic situations. No I haven't opted for hostel because I live with my family in the same city. The average rental is like 60000/- p. a. Both kind of rooms are available for students Suits rooms and normal rooms. Proper facilities are given to the hostlers.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: 70–85% of the students were placed in my course. The highest package was INR 29 lacs per annum. The average package was INR 7 lacs per annum and the lowest package was INR 5 lacs per annum. Some of the top recruiting companies for my course were JP Morgan, Deloitte and more.
content.Infrastructure: My college hosts a good ambience. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and libraries are all present. The college has also got on-campus hostel students outside of Jaipur. The quality of food in the college canteen and hostel mess is hygienic and it tastes good.

paragraphs: Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology admission 2025is currently open for various courses. The institute offers courses, such as BTech, BCA, MBA, etc., at the UG and PG level. The university also offers doctorate courses besides the UG and PG courses. To get admitted to RIET, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute. TheRajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technologyapplication process is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutRajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technologycourse admission2025.

Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology admission 2025is entrance-based. The university also accepts national-level entrance exams like JEE Main, CMAT, etc for admission to courses like MBA, BTech etc. The college offers more than 10 courses in various streams such as Engineering, Computer Application, etc. Check out the following table for details aroundRajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology course admissions2025:

Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology admissionsare completely entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology is as per the steps below:
STEP 1: Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online at the official website (https://www.rietjaipur.ac.in/admission/). Aspirants must visit the official website to apply for various courses such as BTech, MCA for MBA etc. Candidates can fill out the application form on the institute's official website. However, candidates looking for PhD course admission, candidates must apply here, i.e., https://www.rtu.ac.in/RTU/phd.
STEP 2: Selection

Students will be selected based on entrance exams such as JEE Main, NIMCET etc scores as per respective courses. Candidates also need to go through REAP counselling for the BTech course. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the institute selects PhD candidates based on RTU-DAT (Doctoral Admission Test).
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The institute also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theRajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology feeto confirm their seats in the institute.

Library is common for us and engineering branches having less space due to which it is always crowded. I did not live in the hostel, I lived with my family in the same city. The average rent is 60,000 per year and both normal and suite rooms are available for the students. Proper hygienic food is prepared in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: A college needs good management.
reviews.review_text: The whole infrastructure of the college is good. But the condition of the labs is so bad that no practicals can be done on the system. The quality of food provided is average. Wi-Fi facility is provided to the students for study. The environment of the classroom is good in the college.

reviews.review_heading: College campus is very good.
reviews.review_text: Girls and boys are in equal no. Every Week seminars are held. Seminars on most trending topics are held time to time. College do no support any kind of race religion based group. They tend to provide general awareness about recent economic situations. No I haven't opted for hostel because I live with my family in the same city. The average rental is like 60000/- p. a. Both kind of rooms are available for students Suits rooms and normal rooms. Proper facilities are given to the hostlers.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: My college hosts a good ambience. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and libraries are all present. The college has also got on-campus hostel students outside of Jaipur. The quality of food in the college canteen and hostel mess is hygienic and it tastes good.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placement and affordable fee.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our department are that Wi-Fi is available to us and the library is big, consisting of all kinds of books and journals for our reference and our course. The quality of the food is not good at all in terms of the number of times that we pay for the mess food and the same has been complained about several times but no action has been taken.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with supportive batch and teachers.
reviews.review_text: The quality of food is good and the environment is also well cleaned and hygienic. The staff is good in nature and supportive also. They help us in our studies as well as for entertainment purposes also. Wi-Fi is also available in both classrooms and hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: There are around 70% of boys and 30% of girls in our college. Our college has various societies to participate in like drama, dance, art, etc. Our college has friendly environment.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best in Jaipur, and it is awarded as well.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are fine. Our college infrastructure is good. It includes 2 boys hostels and 2 girls hostels with high internet speed. The food is very hygienic. Our campus premises are green and eco-friendly. Many restrooms are available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: RIET gives you a great experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The college gets repainted and repaired every few years, so it remains as fresh as new. The college offers world-class hostel facilities. It also boasts an extremely good campus and labs with up-to-date technologies.

reviews.review_heading: It is a bad and the worst college for engineering.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not working since the first year. The labs are dirty and the classrooms are also dirty. Library not opened for 1-2 years. The hostel is a little bit goof but not that much. The food served in the mess is also poor. There are no sports or games. The food of canteen is very bad and now that the canteen is closed permanently.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with college because of faculty and their behavior.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty much good. There are proper rooms. Labs are good for the mechanical branch. The ground and library are also well maintained. The canteen is not so good. Sports are good for students. Volleyball and boxing facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with all facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are up to date. The hostels are clean and hygienic. The availability of a washer is also there. The environment of the hostel is also good. Wardens of both male and female hostels are supportive. The mess is properly maintained. The food is made hygienically, and the menu is always sent a day before to all the hostellers. An ambulance is available 24x7 for any emergency.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied only with placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is fast only in the admin block. However, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, but the speed is slow. Library Wi-Fi also has good speed. The canteen is closed due to covid, but medical facilities and sports facilities are available here. The mess is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Review of RIET Jaipur - Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are fully furnished. The faculty are perfect, and the teachers and HODs are very helpful. There is one central library and one law library. The labs for science students, i.e., B.Sc. LL.B., are extremely good, and the teachers, for the same, help the students in need. The hostel facilities are up to date.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, with peaceful greenery. Classrooms and outdoor areas are clean and well maintained. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, with passwords provided. The library and labs are present with good equipment and updated systems. Canteen food is good and very hygienic. Medical facilities are provided for hostel students inside the campus. Sports and games are conducted every year with prize distribution.

reviews.review_heading: Innovative information technology, and i miss my college days.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good and very clean. Classrooms are also very good, with good ventilation and fresh air, making them very pleasant. Wi-Fi is present on the campus, and passwords are pasted outside. The library is available with well-stocked books, and a digital library is also provided with updated systems that anyone can use. The hostel is acceptable, and the food is good with daily changes in the menu. Sports and games are conducted every month.

reviews.review_heading: Information technology is good in all activities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good with many mango trees and very attractive, and peacefulness is included when we go there. Coming to the hostel, the food is good and the menu changes every day, separate menu for weekends. Sports and games are conducted every 3 months, the final sports will be conducted and many prizes are distributed on annual day.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and qualified faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good with a good atmosphere, and Wi-Fi is available, but the signal will not come; mobile phone signals also do not come in college. The quality of the hostel is acceptable, but proper maintenance is not there. The food is good with a daily change of menu, and weekly there is non-veg. Medical facilities are provided inside the college only for hostelers. Sports and games are conducted every month.

reviews.review_heading: Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus maintenance are good. However, Wi-Fi is not available around the campus, and mobile signal strength is also not very good. The library is well-equipped with a good collection of books. Hostel food is acceptable, with good taste and a weekly changing menu. Sports and games are conducted every year, and prizes are distributed on annual day.

reviews.review_heading: Innovative information technology.

Both a digital library and a normal library are available with many books. The quality of food in the hostel is acceptable, and medical facilities are not provided inside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, infrastructure and faculty.

Labs are maintained with fully updated systems, and fast internet connections. Hostel food is good and hygienic. A changing menu every day and non-veg served once per week. Medical facilities are provided for hostel students. Sports and games are conducted every year.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and the best people in life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good with neat classrooms, updated systems in labs, and proper ventilation. The hostel food is hygienic with a daily changing menu and weekly non-veg once a week, and the rooms are acceptable. Medical facilities are available only for hostel students. Sports and games are conducted every year and selections are also made.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good, and the Wi-Fi is available throughout the college. Classrooms are good with ventilation and a fresh atmosphere. Both digital and normal libraries are available, and anyone can use them and create an account. Hostel food is good with a daily change of menu and good value for money. Sports and games are conducted every year, and prizes are distributed.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good with a fresh atmosphere. The quality of facilities is good. The hostel food is acceptable with a variety of food and a daily change of menu. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college. Medical facilities are available only for hostelers. Sports and games are conducted every year with certificates and prizes.

reviews.review_heading: If you want a good future, join our college.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we have good infrastructure and basic facilities. We have proper Wi-Fi, drinking water, and the best library. Hostel food is good, and everyone should be equal. In every one-day non-vegetarian food, three days of egg should be provided. Unlimited food is provided to students.

reviews.review_heading: SRK college is the best. It provides good placements 2025.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good but the labs are not provided properly with updated systems. The labs are not having good ventilation, it should be developed. reviews.review_heading: Choose SRK Institute of Technology for the bright future.

Two types of libraries were present. A digital library and a normal library. Anything could be taken and returned carefully after completion.

reviews.review_heading: Information Technology was the best choice.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were good, and labs were provided with separate systems for everyone. The updated versions were present. review_content.Placements: Around 50 students got placed on campus out of around 250 students, with the median package being below 3 LPA. Not even service-based companies like TCS, Wipro come to hire. Most students have to opt for off-campus opportunities. Although, compared to other colleges of its league, placement in core branches like Mechanical and Electrical is great because the college is located in an industrial area.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus has a great gym, playground, swimming pool, and canteen available to students, but the college campus is quite small in comparison. The college has tie-ups with a few PGs available for both girls and boys. We can play football and cricket on the ground during breaks, and there is a water cooler facility (though not that good). The campus is beautiful but very small, and you will struggle with mobile network connectivity due to the location. Also, since we have a TCS ion center where exams are conducted regularly, the jammers cause a huge problem for the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: My college- Angel or Devil of my life.

review_content.Placements: When I joined IIE in 2022, the student who got the highest package was worth INR 3.6 LPA. So from this, we can conclude that if you want placement, do not rely on college; just start preparing all by yourself and try off-campus if you want to get a job. If you talk about my branch, there are many opportunities, and if you are good at coding, you will get some good jobs.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good according to student capacity; we have a library with well-equipped books but for the CSE department, the computer lab is terrible. The computers are very slow; it takes up to 30 minutes just to boost up. After talking with the principal, the management is now upgrading the lab. There is no hostel in the college; it is under construction, although the college will assist you with PG.

paragraphs: Ideal Institute of Engineering admissionsare conducted in online mode. The college admission process contains various steps, including registration, selection, and fee payment for final seat confirmation. placement_data.title: Ideal Institute of Engineering Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: Ideal Institute of Engineering (IIE) has a Training and Placement Cell that ensures placement assistance to every student. It offers pre-placement training to its students in the area of both technical and soft skills, to make them ‘Plug & Play’ in the industry. The Cell also networks with the institution’s alumni to connect, ideate and showcase the lessons, learnings and practices from the ground. The placement team invites companies from different sectors to conduct the placement process at the Campus premises.

The institute has recorded over 100 placements during the 2025 placement season. The highest package recorded during IIE Kalyani placements was INR 11.50 LPA. Earlier in 2024, the highest and lowest packages offered to CSE students during Ideal Institute of Engineering placements in 2024 were INR 6.40 LPA and INR 3.50 LPA, respectively . The highest and lowest packages offered to Civil students of the BTech batch 2024 were INR 5.50 LPA and INR 2.40 LPA, respectively. The top recruiters of Ideal Institute of Engineering placements in 2024 included Infosys, Deloitte, TCS, Capgemini, Amazon, Genpact, JSW, Capgemini, Genesys, PwC, L&T, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the best faculties, placement guidance, and other co-curricular acti
reviews.review_text: Good quality labs with computers which were bought the previous month only. Library is available with plenty of books in varying fields and along with journals. Classrooms are very good with smart board facilities. Canteen, massage, and medical facilities are available. Playground is there inside the campus and various outdoor games are also played.

reviews.review_heading: Below-average college, only take admission if you don't have any other option.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a great gym, playground, swimming pool, and canteen available to students, but the college campus is quite small in comparison. The college has tie-ups with a few PGs available for both girls and boys. We can play football and cricket on the ground during breaks, and there is a water cooler facility (though not that good). The campus is beautiful but very small, and you will struggle with mobile network connectivity due to the location. Also, since we have a TCS ion center where e...

reviews.review_heading: My college- Angel or Devil of my life.
reviews.review_text:
The college infrastructure is good according to student capacity; we have a library with well-equipped books but for the CSE department, the computer lab is terrible. The computers are very slow; it takes up to 30 minutes just to boost up. After talking with the principal, the management is now upgrading the lab.
There is no hostel in the college; it is under construction, although the college will assist you with PG.

reviews.review_heading: Good college. I really liked it.
reviews.review_text: College facilities are really good. Wi-Fi is very good. Faculty members are also good in my course. Hostel is good. Canteen is really well maintained and hygienic. Sports ground is really big and good.

reviews.review_heading: It is good value for money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, labs, the library, and the canteen are good enough for this price. Hostel life is very good. The quality of food is far better than at other college canteens.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good infrastructure, classrooms, laboratories, library, and helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories, classrooms, library all were in good condition. The available food in the canteen was decent. Medical facilities were good. Sports were also good as here organise many competitions like football, cricket, indoor games like carrom, chess, etc. Students can take part in these competitions and increase their marks for the MAKAUT board.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in India with the best faculty and learning system.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, and the canteen is the best. Faculty members are good. Sports games are played. The library is available and the classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is available. Grooming classes are taken every day on how to give interviews, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The worst college with fake campusing.
reviews.review_text: The worst. As I studied here so I know the reality the quality of the food is worse in canteen and hostel as well. As well as hostel facility is the worst for which they used to charge. Don't go for this college to ruin your career at the end of the day you will understand my words.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are good, and it is improved every year.
reviews.review_text: The college provides many facilities for students. All departments like electrical, mechanical, civil and computer classrooms are much impressive. Wi-Fi facility is available. Multi-tasking lab and library are also available. There is a canteen at a cheap rate. Medical facilities are available. A playground is also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: I am impressed with the fest organised in 2016.
reviews.review_text: There are ample classrooms with enough windows to let the fresh air and light pass through. The location of the institute is very well as there are ample options for transport. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and enough books and magazines are available in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members of the college are very useful.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi facility which is very useful. Labs are cool, and the classrooms and library are neat and clean. The college provides a coach for football. Food served in the canteen is awesome. Hostel rooms are not that big, but we can manage. I didn't face any infrastructure related issues during my tenure.

reviews.review_heading: I would suggest not to go for this college if you have any other better options.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. The number of faculty members in the CE department has decreased after we passed out. Computer labs are decent. Wi-Fi provided is of no use. There will be no significant training or internships provided by the college authority. The library is useful enough for your semester exams.

reviews.review_heading: An ideal institute for engineering with satisfying facilities and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college premises is very big and spacious. There are an adequate amount of classrooms, and they are well-equipped. The labs are well-equipped, and there is a big playground for sports and other cultural activities. There is also a canteen on the college premises to get good and fresh food.

reviews.review_heading: A place to be free, and experience the duties and grow.
reviews.review_text: The building is well maintained, clean and well equipped with all the test machines. A football ground and a common room are available for athletic needs of students. A medical room is equipped with a bed, and it is kept clean and ready. The common room includes a table tennis table, carrom and chess boards. A stable Wi-Fi connection is available on the campus. A sufficient number of books are available in the library. A xerox centre is also available for needs.
